from register.models import *
from register.utils import *
import csv
f=open('nxtgn260611.csv', 'r')
h=csv.reader(f)
k=[]
for i in h:
	if "/" not in i[8]:
		if not int(i[8].split("-")[2]) < 2013:
			k.append(i)
for i in k:
	k_id=Kids_ID()
	Register.objects.create(glastname=i[0], gfirstname=i[1], email_add=i[2], mobile=i[3], relationship=i[4], lastname=i[5], firstname=i[6], nickname=i[7], birthdate=datetime.strptime(i[8], "%m-%d-%Y"), gender=i[9], spneeds=i[10].lower(), allergy=i[11], k_id=k_id)
	MkQr(k_id)





for i in k:
	if i[4] != "Father" and i[4] != "Mother":
		k_id=Kids_ID()
		Register.objects.create(glastname=i[0], gfirstname=i[1], email_add=i[2], mobile=i[3], relationship=i[4], lastname=i[5], firstname=i[6], nickname=i[7], birthdate=datetime.strptime(i[8], "%m-%d-%Y"), gender=i[9], spneeds=i[10], allergy=i[11], k_id=k_id)
		MkQr(k_id)



def gname(x, y):
	k=" ".join((y, x))
	return k





def skidate(x):
	if not int(x.split("-")[2]) < 2013:
		return x
		

Register.objects.create(lastname=lastname, firstname=firstname, nickname=nickname, gender=gender, address=address, nationality=nationality, birthdate=datetime.strptime(birthdate, "%Y-%m-%d"), spneeds=spneeds, allergy=allergy, mobile=mobile, guardian=guardian, relationship=relationship, dgroupmember=dgroupmember, pdglead=pdglead, email_add=emailadd, k_id=k_id)
